stem: Meera's teacher says, "Our Earth has plenty of water, so we can never face a water shortage." Why is this not correct?

options.text: All of Earth's water is freshwater stored in rivers and lakes
Most of Earth's water is salty seawater, which is not fit for drinking or farming
Earth's water dries up completely every summer
Rainwater is the only water available on Earth

teacher.key_rationale: Most of Earth's water is saline ocean water, unfit for domestic, agricultural, or industrial use; usable freshwater is limited, so water shortage can occur despite abundant surface water. Option B states this correctly; A, C, D are factually wrong.
